slides.name: cover
slides.headline: Your AI trainer met you 10 seconds ago.
slides.body: 8 lines that make it plan for you. Each one tested on a real AI →

items.title: Lazy ask:
lines: “Make me fit.”

items.title: Sharp ask:
lines: + 1 line about you

slides.name: casting
slides.headline: He only knows what you tell him.
slides.body: Think of AI as a brilliant new trainer. He knows every exercise. He knows nothing about you.

items.title: Lazy ask
lines: his generic plan, the same for everyone

items.title: Sharp ask
lines: one added line, a plan for you

items.text: Next 8 slides: same AI, same question, one line added. Real runs on Claude Fable 5.2, 22 Nov 2026.

slides.name: t1
slides.headline: Tell him who you are.
slides.body: Day 1, you'd tell a trainer your job, what you eat and when.
slides.copy: Add: This is for me: [age], [job], [what I eat], [my timings].

before.title: LAZY ASK · run 1
lines: “Suggest a diet to lose weight.”
→ “…Protein first: 1.6–2 g per kg of body weight (eggs, chicken, fish, paneer…”

after.title: SHARP ASK · run 1 · test persona
lines: + “This is for me: 34, bank job… vegetarian, lunch from the office canteen, dinner at 9:30 pm…”
→ “Canteen lunch: Half plate sabzi/salad… 5 pm snack… so you aren't starving at 9:30.”

slides.name: t2
slides.headline: Tell him how you want it.
slides.body: Under the bar you remember 5 short cues, not a lecture.
slides.copy: Add: Answer in 5 bullets, in the order I do them, max 8 words each.

before.title: LAZY ASK · run 1
lines: “How do I deadlift with correct form?”
→ over 300 words: “Setup… The lift… Lowering… Common mistakes… Getting started…”

after.title: SHARP ASK · run 1 · 5 bullets
lines: + the line above
→ “Stand mid-foot under bar, feet hip-width apart.
… Push floor away, keeping bar against legs.
Lock hips out, then lower with control.”

slides.name: t3
slides.headline: Tell him your limits.
slides.body: You'd say: no eggs, small budget, one burner at home. Work inside that.
slides.copy: Add: Must: [your limits]. Must not: [what is off the table].

before.title: LAZY ASK · run 1
lines: “Suggest a high-protein dinner.”
→ “Chicken and paneer bowl (~60 g protein)… 150 g grilled chicken breast…”

after.title: SHARP ASK · run 1 · AI's estimates
lines: + “Must: vegetarian, no eggs, under Rs 100, cooked on one gas burner. Must not: protein powder.”
→ “Soya chunk and moong dal khichdi (one pot, ~Rs 60-70)… Roughly 40 g protein.”

slides.name: t4
slides.headline: Let him ask you first.
slides.body: A good trainer asks your goal, days and injuries first.
slides.copy: Add: Before you start, ask me up to 3 questions.

before.title: LAZY ASK · run 1
lines: “Make me a weekly workout plan.”
→ “Mon – Push: bench press… Tue – Pull: deadlifts, pull-ups… Thu – Legs: squats… lunges…”

after.title: SHARP ASK · run 1 · scripted reply
lines: + the line above. He asked: “…any injuries or exercises to avoid?”
Test reply: “…two 10 kg dumbbells, and my left knee hurts on deep squats.”
→ “Box squat to a chair (pain-free depth only)”

slides.name: t5
slides.headline: Tell him not to guess.
slides.body: A good trainer measures you. He doesn't guess.
slides.copy: Add: Use only what I told you. Where you need something I didn't give, write [ASK ME] instead of assuming.

before.title: LAZY ASK · run 2
lines: “I'm 78 kg and want to lose fat. Tell me my daily calories and protein.”
→ “Start at about 2,000 kcal… assuming you are moderately active…”

after.title: SHARP ASK · run 2 · test persona
lines: + the line above
→ “Calories: [ASK ME]. I can't give a number from weight alone.”

slides.name: t6
slides.headline: Show him what you like.
slides.body: Show a trainer a video: squat like this. (The smallest change of the 8.)
slides.copy: Add: I like ones like “[example 1]” and “[example 2]”.

before.title: LAZY ASK · run 1
lines: “Suggest 5 names for our 6 am gym WhatsApp group.”
→ “Dawn Patrol… Rise and Grind Crew…”

after.title: SHARP ASK · run 1
lines: + “We like names like “Sore But Showing Up” and “Alarm Beaters 5:30”.”
→ “Tired But Present 6:00… Half Asleep, Full Sets…”

items.text: Run 2, lazy: “Snooze Is for the Weak”. Sharp: “Still Dark, Still Lifting”.

slides.name: t7
slides.headline: Plan 2 weeks. Then check in.
slides.body: A trainer plans 2 weeks, sees how your body takes it, then plans the next 2.
slides.copy: Add: Give me the first part only. Then stop and ask me how it went.

before.title: LAZY ASK · run 1
lines: “Make me a 12-week plan to go from no running to a 5 km run.”
→ all 12 weeks in one table, fixed on day 1

after.title: SHARP ASK · run 1 · scripted reply
lines: + “Give me weeks 1 and 2 only… Then stop and ask me how it went.”
Test reply: “…my left shin hurt…”
→ “Before week 3: rest until the shin is pain-free…”

slides.name: t8
slides.headline: Make him show the maths.
slides.body: Like a gym bill: item by item. Checkable, not more correct.
slides.copy: Add: Show the number next to each item, add them up, and tell me honestly if the total misses my target.

before.title: LAZY ASK · run 2
lines: “Give me one day of vegetarian eating: 1,800 calories and 100 g protein.”
→ “about 1,800 kcal and 105 g protein” · its meals add to 1,775 kcal, 109 g

after.title: SHARP ASK · run 2 · AI's estimates
lines: + the line above
→ “Paneer, 100 g: 265 kcal, 18 g…” “Total: 1,803 kcal, 114 g protein” (adds up)
